# Minnesota.gov

> > Official website of the State of Minnesota, providing access to government services, educational resources, and public information for Minnesota residents and stakeholders.

Minnesota.gov serves as the central digital gateway for state government services, with significant education content managed by the Minnesota Department of Education (MDE). The site supports K-12 education initiatives including the Due North Education Plan, accessibility services like the Minnesota Braille and Talking Book Library, and standardized testing programs such as GED and HiSET.

## Key Topics

- Minnesota Department of Education (MDE)
- Due North Education Plan
- K-12 Education
- School Technology
- Educational Technology
- Minnesota Braille and Talking Book Library
- Minnesota Resource Center Libraries
- GED and HiSET Testing
- Section 504 Compliance
- U.S. Senate Youth Program
- Educational Resources
- Minnesota Education Policy
- Accessibility Services
- Student Assessment
- Technology Integration

## School Technology and Educational Resources

- [School Technology](https://education.mn.gov/mde/dse/tech/): MDE school technology resources and K-12 educational technology programs
